title: HomeInventBox
description: HomeInventBox is a inventory manager for home where a user can manage a home inventory by adding, editing, or deleting items with category and location. It is written in C# using ETO.Forms framework and tested in XUnit framework. It works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux.

title: Bit Shifter Test
description: An application that shows the time for each of the operations shown. It includes multiplication by 2, division by 2, bit shift to the left and right by 1. It is written in C#, XAML, and using Avalonia UI framework.
